thread:
dana: Heads-up — planning a slow enable of nebula-13b-v2-quant into the model catalog tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary start 10% with staged ramps. Need to update fallback ordering for experimental entries and apply a pin for payments routes. Telemetry backstop will be enforced.
kevin: sounds fine. can you spell out the fallback ordering you want to use?
sara: adding — please include a pin request for any route marked critical (payments, auth). i'll take payments.
dana: current default is quant -> float -> legacy. proposal: keep quant first for non-critical routes, but use an entropy-first override for routes tagged safety-sensitive so they prefer float variants. will show config in thread.
matt: +1 for telemetry backstop. recommend automatic rollback if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 latency increases > 30% vs baseline for 5m. also set a deploybot hold at 25% so we can manually ack before larger ramps.
deploybot: /deploy enable-model nebula-13b-v2-quant --canary=10 --window=2026-03-22T02:00Z/2026-03-22T04:00Z --notify=eng-releases
eva: small nit — release notes link? product/compliance will want a short summary and the quantization notes.
dana: will draft notes. quick config snippet for ops/catalog team to apply:```yaml
catalog_entry:
  model: nebula-13b-v2-quant
  fallback_order: ["nebula-13b-v2-quant","nebula-13b-v2","nebula-13b-legacy"]
  tags: ["experimental"]
  canary: 10
  change_window: "02:00-04:00 UTC"
  telemetry_backstop:
    error_rate_pct: 0.5
    p95_latency_increase_pct: 30
    evaluation_window_minutes: 5
```
kevin: ok. operational decision: do NOT change fallback ordering for routes with tag "critical" — instead apply an explicit pin to the current stable model.
sara: pin request posted for payments: `/catalog pin payments nebula-13b-v2@2026-03-21 --reason="protect txn latency/quality"` — please approve.
ops-bot: Pin request queued. Approvers: @kevin, @dana.
kevin: approved. applying pin for payments now.
deploybot: Canary scheduled — will start at 2026-03-22T02:00:05Z (10% traffic). Observability snapshot will be available once streaming begins.
matt: i'll be oncall for the window and watching traces/kv cache hit rates. if the backstop triggers i'll initiate rollback.
eva: draft release notes: "nebula-13b-v2-quant: quantized lower-latency variant, 10% canary, experimental fallback ordering for non-critical routes. Backstop: auto-rollback on elevated errors/latency." link to doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/rollouts/nebula-quant-2026
deploybot: Canary started — 10% traffic at 2026-03-22T02:00:05Z. Telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/rollouts/1789991111
matt: seeing p95 spike to ~950ms (baseline 720ms) but error rate 0.02% — within backstop thresholds, continuing watch.
dana: ramp plan: 10% -> 25% (after 20m manual ack) -> 50% (after another 20m) with a deploybot hold at 25% for manual review. fallback ordering change only applied to entries tagged "experimental". payments is pinned to nebula-13b-v2.
sara: product and compliance notified. i'll post short release note in #announcements post-cutover.
dana: final: if backstop trips, deploybot will rollback to previous catalog state and notify oncall and #incidents. otherwise will post final rollout summary and update the model catalog entry to remove the experimental tag after 72h. :eyes:
kevin: thanks — i'll be available for the 25% manual ack.
matt: ack, monitoring.
deploybot: Hold reached at 25% — awaiting manual ack from approvers to continue ramp.
sara: payments pin verified.
dana: manual ack granted, proceed to 50%.
deploybot: Ramp to 50% complete. No backstop triggered so far. Telemetry summary: https://telemetry.internal/rollouts/1789991111/summary
kevin: nice work. will keep an eye for regression alerts.
dana: thanks team — i'll post the post-rollout notes and update the catalog entry tomorrow.
